notes.text: The layout tree treats ordinary elements with the same default block style unless author CSS overrides them; address, p, headings, blockquote, figure, and pre receive a narrow set of UA text metrics and spacing defaults.
Native dialog centering, modal top-layer behavior, and backdrops are not modeled.

Address, paragraph, blockquote, figure, pre, hr, details/summary, hidden including until-found, and basic dialog open/closed behavior have parity coverage in non-collapsing block flow; text element spacing is verified with explicit line metrics so host fonts do not change the oracle.
Closed details content is suppressed from layout and hit testing; Chromium still exposes non-zero rects for the suppressed descendants, which this engine does not model.
